itemdesc-gear-quarter: Worth 0.25 rusty gear at a Banker. Four quarters craft into one whole rusty gear.
itemdesc-bank-statement: An immutable account snapshot. Hold it to read its contents, or craft it into a generic scrap.
itemdesc-statement-scrap: A generic paper scrap with no surviving account information.
bank-welcome: Welcome. The Bank shall attend to your account.
bank-ready: How may the Bank be of service?
bank-timeout: No reply yet. Retry the request or close this window.
bank-uncertain: The transaction outcome is not yet known. Retry checks the same request; it does not submit another transaction.
bank-check-history: The outcome may be uncertain. Reopen the ledger and check history before attempting this transaction again.
bank-bad-reply: The Bank's reply could not be read. An outstanding transaction has not been assumed to fail.
bank-committed: The Bank has confirmed the transaction.
bank-no-statement: No current statement is available. Refresh to request one. If you have no account yet, a first deposit or incoming transfer opens it.
bank-rounding: Rounded displays do not discard any remainder. Physical withdrawals must be exactly representable in accepted gears.
bank-cash-help: Use your own hotbar and backpack. Rusty cash uses whole gears and quarters; temporal cash uses whole gears. Enter a decimal point, without grouping separators. The Bank will review the exact amount before confirmation.
bank-transfer-help: Transfers move rusty savings only. Resolve the recipient and review the Bank's confirmation before sending.
bank-all-at-commit: entire balance; exact amount determined at commit
bank-cash-recheck: The Bank will check funds and inventory again at commit. Nothing is reserved by this preview, and no partial amount will be moved.
bank-confirm-print: Consume one sheet of paper and print this statement? Only one successful print is allowed during this Banker conversation.
bank-statement-rates: Rates (annual continuous / monthly effective / annual effective): {0} / {1} / {2}.
bank-statement-cd: CD: principal {0}; current value {1}; maturity {2} at month {3}; locked yield {4}.
bank-statement-historical-notice: This is a historical snapshot. It does not prove the current balance or authorize a transaction.
bank-statement-unreadable: This statement's contents cannot be read.
bank-irreversible: This transfer is immediate and final. There is no fee, cancellation, or partial transfer.
bank-cd-help: New CD principal in rusty gears (minimum at opening: {0}). Current contract values below are informational and cannot be spent.
bank-cd-values: Principal {0} • informational value {1} • maturity {2} rusty gears
bank-projected-maturity: Projected calendar maturity: {0} (may change if the calendar is reanchored)
bank-runtime-maturity: Maturity follows active server runtime, not an in-world calendar date.
bank-confirm-cd:
Purchase a CD for exactly {0} rusty gears?
Term: {1} financial months from purchase
Exact maturity payoff: {2} rusty gears
bank-quote-components:
Annual continuous components:
Risk-free {0}; base spread {1}; level {2}; slope {3}; liquidity {4}
bank-cd-lockup: The principal is locked until maturity. There is no early redemption. The offer expires after 30 real seconds; the Bank rechecks expiry at commit.
bank-notice-history: Individual details are retained in your history.
bank-error-InvalidAmount: Enter a positive amount using the permitted decimal precision.
bank-error-InvalidCurrency: That currency is not supported for this operation.
bank-error-InsufficientFunds: The account has insufficient funds. No partial transaction was made.
bank-error-BalanceCap: This transaction would exceed an account's balance cap.
bank-error-ArithmeticFault: The Bank could not represent this financial operation safely.
bank-error-InvalidTime: The Bank's financial clock is unavailable.
bank-error-NoAccount: No account exists yet. A first deposit or incoming transfer opens one.
bank-error-UnknownRecipient: That recipient is not known in this world's current name registry.
bank-error-AmbiguousRecipient: That name is ambiguous. The Bank cannot safely identify one recipient.
bank-error-RecipientServiceUnavailable: The recipient directory is unavailable. Other banking services may still be used.
bank-error-SelfTransfer: You cannot transfer savings to yourself.
bank-error-InvalidSession: This Banker conversation is no longer available. Close the ledger and speak to a Banker again.
bank-error-InvalidSequence: The request sequence is no longer valid. Reopen the ledger before continuing.
bank-error-PayloadMismatch: The request does not match its earlier submission. Reopen the ledger and check history.
bank-error-AlreadyProcessedResponseExpir: This request was already processed, but its reply has expired. Check history; do not submit it again.
bank-error-ExpiredConfirmation: The offer or recipient confirmation expired or changed. Request a fresh review.
bank-error-Cooldown: Please wait briefly before making another transfer.
bank-error-InvalidDenomination: The exact amount cannot be represented in the accepted physical gear denominations.
bank-error-InventoryUnavailable: The required gears are unavailable, or your inventory cannot accept the complete withdrawal.
bank-error-PermissionDenied: This operation is not available under the server's settings or your permissions.
bank-error-InvalidConfiguration: The Bank's configuration is invalid. Contact a server administrator.
bank-error-CorruptState: The Bank's saved authority is unavailable. Contact a server administrator.
bank-error-PrintAllowanceUsed: A statement has already been printed during this Banker conversation.
bank-error-InvalidRequest: The Bank could not accept this request. Check the entered values.
bank-error-ServiceUnavailable: The banking service is unavailable. Contact a server administrator if this persists.
bank-error-Suspended: The server is paused. Banking will resume with the world.
bank-error-ResponseTooLarge: The requested display is too large. Request a smaller page.
bank-error-Starting: The Bank is still opening. Please try again shortly.
charter-status-checking: The Bank is inspecting these premises.
charter-status-facing: No branch is active: the Charter must have a valid horizontal wall facing.
charter-status-room: No branch is active: no enclosed room was recognized behind the Charter.
charter-status-unloaded: No branch is active: every chunk containing the premises must be loaded.
charter-status-enclosure: No branch is active: the room is not fully enclosed by walls, roof, and closed doors.
charter-status-size: No branch is active: the interior must be 5–13 blocks wide, 5–13 blocks long, and 2–13 blocks high.
charter-status-anchor: No branch is active: the Charter must occupy the recognized room interior.
charter-status-complex: No branch is active: the premises are too complex to protect safely.
charter-status-charter-count: No branch is active: the premises must contain exactly one Banker’s Charter.
charter-status-door: No branch is active: the premises need a door.
charter-status-table: No branch is active: the premises need a table or desk.
charter-status-seat: No branch is active: the premises need a chair or stool.
charter-status-storage: No branch is active: the premises need a storage container such as a chest.
charter-status-light: No branch is active: the premises need an artificial light such as a chandelier.
charter-status-flower: No branch is active: the premises need a flowerpot containing a flower.
charter-status-floor: No branch is active: the premises need a complete supported 5×5 floor area with two-block headroom.
charter-status-standing: No branch is active: the premises have no safe dry standing place for a Banker.
charter-status-topology: The branch arrival wait is paused: the protected room layout changed after acceptance.
charter-status-permission: No branch is active: the placer lacks build permission over the whole premises.
charter-status-conflict: No branch is active: another branch conflicts with these premises.
charter-status-waiting: The premises are protected. A Banker is expected after the saved wait and safe placement.
charter-status-vacant: This protected public branch currently has no available Banker.
charter-status-decommissioned: This Charter placement has been administratively decommissioned.
config-interest-time-basis-comment: InGame follows the world calendar; ServerRuntime excludes sleep acceleration.
config-rate-model-comment: CIR varies around the target; Constant holds the configured target.
config-target-rate-comment: Annual effective rate as a ratio; 3 means 300%.
config-cir-speed-comment: Positive speed at which the variable rate returns toward its target.
config-cir-volatility-comment: Positive magnitude of random movement in the variable rate.
config-cd-minimum-comment: Minimum rusty gears accepted when opening a certificate of deposit.
config-cd-tenors-comment: Distinct positive financial months separated by commas.
config-spread-scale-comment: Nonnegative scale applied to the CD term spread.
config-spread-exponent-comment: Positive exponent, no greater than 1, applied to CD term length.
config-level-variance-comment: Nonnegative variance of the zero-mean Gaussian CD level shock.
config-slope-variance-comment: Nonnegative variance of the zero-mean Gaussian CD slope shock.
config-funding-target-comment: Target CD funding share from 0 to 1.
config-scarcity-boost-comment: Largest nonnegative annual continuous yield boost below the funding target.
config-excess-reduction-comment: Largest nonnegative annual continuous yield reduction above the funding target.
config-liquidity-half-life-comment: Positive smoothing half-life in financial months.
config-response-width-comment: Positive width controlling how gradually liquidity pressure responds.
config-display-precision-comment: Decimal places shown in the UI; ledger precision always remains six places.
config-recipient-mode-comment: ExactName requires entry; KnownPlayerListing permits observed player names in the selector.
config-statement-count-comment: Recent transactions included on a printed statement.
config-charter-minimum-comment: Minimum ordinary world days before a valid Charter receives its first Banker.
config-charter-maximum-comment: Maximum ordinary world days before a valid Charter receives its first Banker.
config-replacement-minimum-comment: Minimum ordinary world days before a dead Banker can be replaced.
config-replacement-maximum-comment: Maximum ordinary world days before a dead Banker can be replaced.
config-branch-spacing-comment: Minimum block distance between Charter and natural branch reservations.
config-natural-probability-comment: Probability from 0 to 1 that a generated trader location gains a natural Banker.
config-natural-backfill-comment: Whether eligible already-generated trader locations may receive natural Bankers.
